atlas_3d.install_instructions: Set ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY (ATLAS_CLOUD_API_KEY and ATLAS_API_KEY are also accepted). Create a key at https://www.atlascloud.ai/.

atlas_image.install_instructions:
Set ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY to your Atlas Cloud API key.
  Get one at https://www.atlascloud.ai/ -> Dashboard -> API Keys

atlas_video.install_instructions:
Set ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY to your Atlas Cloud API key.
  Get one at https://www.atlascloud.ai/ -> Dashboard -> API Keys

audio_energy.install_instructions:
Install ffmpeg:
  Windows: winget install ffmpeg
  macOS: brew install ffmpeg
  Linux: sudo apt install ffmpeg

audio_mixer.install_instructions:
FFmpeg is required. pydub is optional for advanced mixing:
pip install pydub

audio_probe.install_instructions:
Install ffmpeg (includes ffprobe):
  Windows: winget install ffmpeg
  macOS: brew install ffmpeg
  Linux: sudo apt install ffmpeg

auto_reframe.install_instructions:
FFmpeg is required. For face-tracked reframing, also install:
pip install mediapipe opencv-python

Without MediaPipe/OpenCV, falls back to center-crop.

azure_stt.install_instructions:
Set your Azure AI Speech credentials:
  export AZURE_SPEECH_KEY=your_speech_resource_key
  export AZURE_SPEECH_REGION=eastus   # your Speech resource region
Create a Speech resource in the Azure portal (https://portal.azure.com) — the key and region are on its 'Keys and Endpoint' page. Optionally set AZURE_SPEECH_ENDPOINT to a full custom endpoint URL instead of the region.

azure_tts.install_instructions:
Set your Azure AI Speech credentials (same resource as azure_stt):
  export AZURE_SPEECH_KEY=your_speech_resource_key
  export AZURE_SPEECH_REGION=eastus   # your Speech resource region
Create a Speech resource in the Azure portal (https://portal.azure.com) — the key and region are on its 'Keys and Endpoint' page. Optionally set AZURE_TTS_ENDPOINT to a full custom TTS host (e.g. https://<region>.tts.speech.microsoft.com).

bg_remove.install_instructions:
pip install rembg       # CPU mode
pip install rembg[gpu]  # GPU mode (requires CUDA + onnxruntime-gpu)

bgm_montage_lite.install_instructions: Clone https://github.com/sharbvane/BMTS-Lite, create an isolated Python 3.11 environment, and install its requirements-runtime.txt. Set BGM_MONTAGE_LITE_ROOT to that checkout and optionally BGM_MONTAGE_LITE_PYTHON to the environment's interpreter. Install FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH. See docs/bgm-montage-lite.md.

blender_world.install_instructions: Install Blender 4.5 LTS, set BLENDER_PATH, or place the portable runtime at .runtime/blender/blender-4.5.10-windows-x64/blender.exe.

cap_recorder.install_instructions:
Cap is a free, open-source Loom alternative.

Install from: https://cap.so/download
  - Windows: Download and run the installer
  - macOS: Download the .dmg or use: brew install --cask cap
  - Linux: Download the AppImage from GitHub releases

Source code: https://github.com/CapSoftware/cap

Cap provides webcam overlay, cursor highlighting, and a polished
recording UI that FFmpeg-based recording cannot match.

cartesia_tts.install_instructions: Configure CARTESIA_API_KEY from the Cartesia dashboard.

clip_search.install_instructions:
pip install numpy transformers torch
Requires a corpus built by corpus_builder at <corpus_dir>.

cogvideo_video.install_instructions:
Enable local video generation and install the diffusers stack:
  export VIDEO_GEN_LOCAL_ENABLED=true
  uv pip install diffusers transformers accelerate torch pillow requests

GPU support — pick what matches your hardware:
  NVIDIA CUDA    — works out of the box with the above
  Apple Silicon (MPS, macOS >= 12.3) — works out of the box; no extra build
  CPU fallback   — slow but functional on any machine

VRAM profile: see the selected tool's resource_profile for minimum VRAM.

comfyui_image.install_instructions:
Start a ComfyUI server and set COMFYUI_SERVER_URL (default http://localhost:8188).
See https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI for setup.
Running a separate ComfyUI instance for images? Set COMFYUI_IMAGE_SERVER_URL instead -- it takes priority over COMFYUI_SERVER_URL for this tool only.

comfyui_music.install_instructions:
Start a ComfyUI server and set COMFYUI_SERVER_URL (default http://localhost:8188).
Requires ace_step_v1_3.5b.safetensors in ComfyUI's checkpoints directory for the bundled workflow.
Running a separate ComfyUI instance for music? Set COMFYUI_MUSIC_SERVER_URL instead -- it takes priority over COMFYUI_SERVER_URL for this tool only.

comfyui_video.install_instructions:
Start a ComfyUI server and set COMFYUI_SERVER_URL (default http://localhost:8188).
Bundled local WAN requires WAN 2.2 models and LightX2V LoRAs. Local MiniMax H3 requires its official model stack and exported API workflow.
Gemini Omni, Seedance 2.5, and MiniMax H3 Partner Nodes require a logged-in Comfy account, credits, and network access.
Running a separate ComfyUI instance for video? Set COMFYUI_VIDEO_SERVER_URL instead -- it takes priority over COMFYUI_SERVER_URL for this tool only.

composition_validator.install_instructions: Requires ffprobe on PATH (part of ffmpeg).

corpus_builder.install_instructions:
pip install opencv-python numpy requests pillow transformers torch
At least one stock source must be configured:
  PEXELS_API_KEY for Pexels (free at https://www.pexels.com/api/)
  UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY for Unsplash (see https://unsplash.com/documentation)
  archive.org, nasa, and wikimedia work without API keys

dashscope_asr.install_instructions:
Set DASHSCOPE_API_KEY to your Alibaba Cloud DashScope API key.
  Get one at https://dashscope.aliyun.com/

dashscope_image.install_instructions:
Set DASHSCOPE_API_KEY to your Alibaba Cloud DashScope API key.
  Get one at https://dashscope.aliyun.com/

dashscope_tts.install_instructions:
Set DASHSCOPE_API_KEY to your Alibaba Cloud DashScope API key.
  Get one at https://dashscope.aliyun.com/

diagram_gen.install_instructions:
For Mermaid diagrams:
  npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
For Pillow-based diagrams (fallback):
  pip install Pillow

direct_clip_search.install_instructions:
At least one stock source must be configured:
  PEXELS_API_KEY for Pexels (free at https://www.pexels.com/api/)
  UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY for Unsplash (see https://unsplash.com/documentation)
  archive.org, nasa, and wikimedia work without API keys

doubao_tts.install_instructions:
Set DOUBAO_SPEECH_API_KEY to a Volcengine Doubao Speech API Key.
Optional: set DOUBAO_SPEECH_VOICE_TYPE to the default speaker voice.
Use the new console API key flow; do not pass app id/access token as the API key.

elevenlabs_tts.install_instructions:
Set the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable:
  export ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=your_key_here
Get a key at https://elevenlabs.io
If fal_elevenlabs_tts is available, use it instead to access ElevenLabs speech through fal.ai without a separate ElevenLabs key.

export_bundle.install_instructions: No setup required — runs locally with the Python standard library.

eye_enhance.install_instructions:
For best results install MediaPipe and OpenCV:
pip install mediapipe opencv-python numpy

Without MediaPipe, falls back to FFmpeg eye-region filter (less precise).

face_restore.install_instructions:
uv pip install gfpgan torch
Works on: CUDA (NVIDIA), MPS (Apple Silicon M-series, macOS >= 12.3), CPU fallback.
No CUDA build needed on macOS — uv pip install torch includes MPS support.

face_tracker.install_instructions:
For best results install MediaPipe:
pip install mediapipe opencv-python

Falls back to OpenCV Haar cascade (ships with opencv-python).

fal_3d.install_instructions: Set FAL_KEY (or FAL_AI_API_KEY). Create a key at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys.

fal_elevenlabs_music.install_instructions: Set FAL_KEY to a fal.ai API key. Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

fal_elevenlabs_tts.install_instructions: Set FAL_KEY to a fal.ai API key. No separate ElevenLabs key is needed. Get a fal.ai key at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

fish_audio_tts.install_instructions:
Set FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY to an API key from https://fish.audio/go-api/api-keys/
Create voice models in the fish.audio playground and pass their id as
reference_id to reuse a cloned voice.

flux_image.install_instructions:
Set FAL_KEY to your fal.ai API key.
  Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

freesound_music.install_instructions:
Set the FREESOUND_API_KEY environment variable:
  export FREESOUND_API_KEY=your_key_here
Get a free key at https://freesound.org/apiv2/apply/

gemini_omni_video.install_instructions:
Set GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY to a Google AI Studio API key.
  Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
  Gemini Omni Flash is paid-tier only (no free tier); ~$0.10 per second of video.

google_imagen.install_instructions:
Auth option A — API key (AI Studio): set GOOGLE_API_KEY (or GEMINI_API_KEY).
  Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
Auth option B — service account (Vertex AI): set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  to a service-account JSON key (needs the 'google-auth' package), plus
  GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and optionally GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION (default us-central1).
  Requires the Vertex AI API enabled and billing on the project.

google_music.install_instructions:
Configure Google credentials:
  - Set GEMINI_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY) in environment.
  - Or set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS for Vertex AI service account.

google_tts.install_instructions:
Auth option A — TTS-only API key: set GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY.
  GOOGLE_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY remain supported for broader Google setups.
  Google Cloud API key with Text-to-Speech enabled.
  Enable the API at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/texttospeech.googleapis.com
Auth option B — service account: set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to the
  path of a service-account JSON key (needs the 'google-auth' package).

green_screen_composite.install_instructions: Install FFmpeg: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html — pip install numpy Pillow

green_screen_processor.install_instructions: Install FFmpeg: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html  For rembg method: pip install rembg[gpu] onnxruntime

grok_image.install_instructions:
Set XAI_API_KEY to your xAI API key.
  Get one from the xAI developer console

grok_video.install_instructions:
Set XAI_API_KEY to your xAI API key.
  Get one from the xAI developer console

heygen_avatar.install_instructions: Configure HEYGEN_API_KEY from your HeyGen API account.

heygen_catalog_tts.install_instructions: Configure HEYGEN_API_KEY; use a catalog voice from /v3/voices.

heygen_video.install_instructions:
Set the HEYGEN_API_KEY environment variable:
  set HEYGEN_API_KEY=your_key_here
Get a key at https://app.heygen.com/settings/api

heygen_voice_convert.install_instructions: Configure HEYGEN_API_KEY; use an ACTIVE workspace instant voice.

higgsfield_video.install_instructions:
Set HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY and HIGGSFIELD_API_SECRET for your Higgsfield Cloud credentials.
  Get them at https://cloud.higgsfield.ai/api-keys
  Alternatively, set HIGGSFIELD_KEY as a combined key:secret value.

hunyuan_cloud_video.install_instructions:
Set TENCENT_TOKENHUB_API_KEY to your Tencent Cloud TokenHub API key.
  Get it at https://console.cloud.tencent.com/tokenhub

hunyuan_image.install_instructions:
Set TENCENT_TOKENHUB_API_KEY to your Tencent Cloud TokenHub API key.
  Get it at https://console.cloud.tencent.com/tokenhub

GPU support — pick what matches your hardware:

hyperframes_compose.install_instructions: Requires Node.js >= 22 (https://nodejs.org/) and FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org/download.html). The HyperFrames CLI is fetched on first use via `npx hyperframes` (npm package: `hyperframes`). Note: the upstream monorepo develops the package as `@hyperframes/cli`, but it publishes to npm as `hyperframes`. `npx @hyperframes/cli` returns 404 -- do NOT use that form. Verify setup with `npx hyperframes doctor` or run the `doctor` operation on this tool.

image_gen.install_instructions:
Set one of these environment variables:
  OPENAI_API_KEY — for GPT Image 2
  FAL_KEY — for FLUX via fal.ai
Or install diffusers for local generation:
  pip install diffusers transformers accelerate torch

inworld_tts.install_instructions: Configure INWORLD_API_KEY with the Base64 credential from the Inworld Portal.

jimeng_video.install_instructions:
Set VOLC_ACCESSKEY and VOLC_SECRETKEY to your Volcengine IAM credentials.
  Get them at https://console.volcengine.com/iam/keymanage
  Ensure your account has access to Jimeng AI (即梦) video generation.

kling_avatar.install_instructions: Set KLING_API_KEY in .env for the official Kling API. Provide an avatar image plus either audio_id or sound_file/audio_path.

kling_lip_sync.install_instructions: Set KLING_API_KEY in .env for the official Kling API. Use identify_face first for multi-person clips, then pass face_choose or face_id.

kling_official_image.install_instructions: Set KLING_API_KEY in .env for the official Kling API. Optionally set KLING_API_BASE_URL to override the default Singapore endpoint.

kling_official_video.install_instructions: Set KLING_API_KEY in .env for the official Kling API. Optionally set KLING_API_BASE_URL to override the default Singapore endpoint.

kling_tts.install_instructions: Set KLING_API_KEY in .env for the official Kling API. Pass voice_id explicitly; OpenMontage does not guess Kling voice IDs.

kling_video.install_instructions:
Set FAL_KEY to your fal.ai API key.
  Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

lip_sync.install_instructions:
Option 1: pip install wav2lip (if available)
Option 2: Clone https://github.com/Rudrabha/Wav2Lip and set WAV2LIP_PATH env var
Requires: PyTorch with CUDA, ffmpeg

local_diffusion.install_instructions:
Install diffusers for local Stable Diffusion:
  pip install diffusers transformers accelerate torch

ltx_video_local.install_instructions:
Enable local video generation and install the diffusers stack:
  export VIDEO_GEN_LOCAL_ENABLED=true
  uv pip install diffusers transformers accelerate torch pillow requests

GPU support — pick what matches your hardware:

  CPU fallback   — slow but functional on any machine

VRAM profile: see the selected tool's resource_profile for minimum VRAM.

ltx_video_modal.install_instructions:
Set the MODAL_LTX2_ENDPOINT_URL environment variable to your deployed LTX endpoint:
  set MODAL_LTX2_ENDPOINT_URL=https://<your-modal-endpoint>

mai_image.install_instructions: Configure MAI_API_KEY, MAI_ENDPOINT (Foundry resource HTTPS origin), MAI_IMAGE_DEPLOYMENT and MAI_IMAGE_MODEL (MAI-Image-2.6 or MAI-Image-2.6-Flash).

mai_tts.install_instructions:
Set your Azure AI Speech credentials (same resource as azure_stt):
  export AZURE_SPEECH_KEY=your_speech_resource_key
  export AZURE_SPEECH_REGION=eastus   # your Speech resource region
Create a Speech resource in the Azure portal (https://portal.azure.com) — the key and region are on its 'Keys and Endpoint' page. Optionally set AZURE_TTS_ENDPOINT to a full custom TTS host (e.g. https://<region>.tts.speech.microsoft.com).

math_animate.install_instructions:
Install ManimCE:
  pip install manim
  manim checkhealth
Requires: Python 3.8+, FFmpeg, LaTeX (optional, for math formulas)
  Windows: choco install miktex ffmpeg
  macOS: brew install mactex ffmpeg
  Linux: sudo apt install texlive-full ffmpeg

minicut_image.install_instructions:
Install the MiniCut CLI: curl -fsSL https://minicut.ai/install.sh | bash
  Then sign in once: minicut login

minicut_music.install_instructions:
Install the MiniCut CLI: curl -fsSL https://minicut.ai/install.sh | bash
  Then sign in once: minicut login

minicut_music_fit.install_instructions:
Install the MiniCut CLI: curl -fsSL https://minicut.ai/install.sh | bash
  Then sign in once: minicut login
  Then add the music tools once (instrument samples, about 396 MB): minicut setup

minicut_sfx.install_instructions:
Install the MiniCut CLI: curl -fsSL https://minicut.ai/install.sh | bash
  Then sign in once: minicut login

minicut_tts.install_instructions:
Install the MiniCut CLI: curl -fsSL https://minicut.ai/install.sh | bash
  Then sign in once: minicut login

minicut_upscale.install_instructions:
Install the MiniCut CLI: curl -fsSL https://minicut.ai/install.sh | bash
  Then sign in once: minicut login

minimax_image.install_instructions: Set MINIMAX_API_KEY to your MiniMax API key. Optionally set MINIMAX_REGION to global or cn.

minimax_video.install_instructions:
Set MINIMAX_API_KEY to your MiniMax API key.
  Get one at https://platform.minimax.io/ (global) or https://platform.minimaxi.com/ (CN).
  Optionally set MINIMAX_REGION=cn to route to the mainland China host, or MINIMAX_BASE_URL to override the endpoint entirely.

music_gen.install_instructions:
Set the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable:
  export ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=your_key_here
Get a key at https://elevenlabs.io

music_library.install_instructions: Create a 'music_library/' folder in the project root and drop royalty-free audio tracks into it (e.g. .mp3, .wav, .m4a, .flac, .ogg). Sources: your own files, YouTube Audio Library, Jamendo, Freesound, etc. Override the location with the MUSIC_LIBRARY_DIR environment variable.

openai_image.install_instructions:
Set OPENAI_API_KEY to your OpenAI API key.
  pip install openai

openai_tts.install_instructions:
Set the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable:
  export OPENAI_API_KEY=your_key_here
Get a key at https://platform.openai.com/

pexels_image.install_instructions:
Set PEXELS_API_KEY to your Pexels API key.
  Get one free at https://www.pexels.com/api/

pexels_video.install_instructions:
Set PEXELS_API_KEY to your Pexels API key.
  Get one free at https://www.pexels.com/api/

pika_video.install_instructions:
Set PIKA_API_KEY to a Pika API key.
  1. Sign in at https://dev.pika.art and create an organization.
  2. Open API Keys and create a key.
  3. Add funds under Billing; generation is prepaid with no free tier.
  Optional: PIKA_API_BASE_URL overrides https://api.dev.pika.art.
  Support: support@pika.art

piper_tts.install_instructions:
Install Piper TTS:
  pip install piper-tts
Or download from https://github.com/rhasspy/piper/releases
Then download a voice model:
  python -m piper.download_voices --download-dir ~/.piper/models en_US-lessac-medium

pixabay_image.install_instructions:
Set PIXABAY_API_KEY to your Pixabay API key.
  Get one free at https://pixabay.com/api/docs/

pixabay_music.install_instructions:
No setup required. Pixabay Music is free and needs no API key.
Note: This tool scrapes the Pixabay website. If it breaks, the
site's HTML structure may have changed. Use freesound_music as fallback.

pixabay_video.install_instructions:
Set PIXABAY_API_KEY to your Pixabay API key.
  Get one free at https://pixabay.com/api/docs/

qwen_image_21.install_instructions: Install Diffusers with QwenImage21Pipeline, torch, transformers >=5.17, accelerate and Pillow. Download Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 separately and set QWEN_IMAGE_21_PATH to its local directory.

realtime_audio.install_instructions: Configure XAI_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, or MAI_API_KEY + MAI_ENDPOINT + MAI_TRANSCRIBE_DEPLOYMENT for the selected provider.

recraft_image.install_instructions:
Set FAL_KEY to your fal.ai API key.
  Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

remotion_caption_burn.install_instructions:
Remotion (optional, preferred): npm install in remotion-composer/
FFmpeg (required for fallback): https://ffmpeg.org/download.html

runway_video.install_instructions:
Set RUNWAY_API_KEY to your Runway API secret.
  Get one at https://dev.runwayml.com/

scene_detect.install_instructions:
FFmpeg is required. For better detection install PySceneDetect:
pip install scenedetect[opencv]

screen_recorder.install_instructions:
Install ffmpeg:
  Windows: winget install ffmpeg
  macOS: brew install ffmpeg
  Linux: sudo apt install ffmpeg

seedance_ark.install_instructions: Set ARK_API_KEY to the API Key body from Volcengine Ark (without the 'Bearer ' prefix). Optional: ARK_SEEDANCE_MODEL and ARK_BASE_URL.

seedance_replicate.install_instructions:
Set REPLICATE_API_TOKEN to your Replicate API token.
  Get one at https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens

seedance_video.install_instructions:
Set FAL_KEY to your fal.ai API key.
  Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

seedream_image.install_instructions:
Set FAL_KEY to your fal.ai API key.
  Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

sora_video.install_instructions:
Set OPENAI_API_KEY to your OpenAI API key with Sora API access.
  pip install 'openai>=2.44.0'

suno_music.install_instructions:
Set the SUNO_API_KEY environment variable:
  export SUNO_API_KEY=your_key_here
Get a key at https://sunoapi.org/api-key

talking_head.install_instructions:
Clone https://github.com/OpenTalker/SadTalker and set SADTALKER_PATH env var
Requires: PyTorch with CUDA, ffmpeg
pip install sadtalker  # or clone the repo

threejs_asset_catalog.install_instructions: Network access for install; no API key. Bundled catalogs are CC0.

threejs_world.install_instructions: World authoring is dependency-free. Final rendering requires the configured HyperFrames runtime (Node.js >= 22, npx, and FFmpeg).

transcriber.install_instructions:
pip install faster-whisper  # CPU mode
pip install faster-whisper[gpu]  # GPU mode (requires CUDA)
pip install whisperx  # For diarization support

upscale.install_instructions:
uv pip install realesrgan torch
Works on: CUDA (NVIDIA), MPS (Apple Silicon M-series, macOS >= 12.3), CPU fallback.

Configure at least one backend API key:
  - Direct Google backend: Configure Vertex AI service-account credentials.
    Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/
    Or set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS for Vertex AI service account.
  - FAL.ai backend: Set FAL_KEY (or FAL_AI_API_KEY).

video_analyzer.install_instructions:
Core: FFmpeg is required (https://ffmpeg.org/download.html)
For URL downloads: pip install yt-dlp
For YouTube transcripts: pip install youtube-transcript-api
For local transcription: pip install faster-whisper
For scene detection: pip install scenedetect[opencv]
All dependencies are free and local — no API keys needed.

For YouTube support, also install Deno (JS runtime): https://deno.land/#installation
Without Deno, YouTube downloads may fail but other platforms still work.

video_stitch.install_instructions:
Install FFmpeg: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
Windows: winget install FFmpeg
macOS: brew install ffmpeg
Linux: sudo apt install ffmpeg

video_trimmer.install_instructions:
Install FFmpeg: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
Windows: winget install FFmpeg

video_understand.install_instructions: pip install transformers torch  # For CLIP/BLIP-2 visual understanding
